# Quest Housing

> Premium rental homes and property management in Bengaluru, India.

Quest Housing is a real estate platform offering 100% verified rental properties in Bengaluru with zero upfront costs. Browse flats, villas, and premium homes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://questhousing.vercel.app): Landing page with featured properties, testimonials, and company overview.
- [Properties](https://questhousing.vercel.app/properties): Browse all available rental listings with filters for BHK, budget, locality, and furnishing.
- [About](https://questhousing.vercel.app/about): Learn about Quest Housing's mission, team, and transparent renting approach.
- [Find My Home](https://questhousing.vercel.app/find-my-home): Guided property finder to match tenants with their ideal rental home.
- [Register](https://questhousing.vercel.app/register): Property owner registration to list properties on the platform.

## Key Features

- Zero upfront cost for tenants
- 100% verified property listings
- Premium furnished and semi-furnished homes
- Property management services for owners
- Schedule visit functionality for interested tenants

## Location

Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India

## Contact

Website: https://questhousing.vercel.app
